name: claude-mods
description: A collection of small Claude Code mods and themes

plugins.name: goland-skin
plugins.description: JetBrains GoLand Darcula colors for Claude Code, plus a matching Warp terminal theme and an optional claude-skins skin. /goland switches it on live.

plugins.name: diagram-preview
plugins.description: Preview Mermaid and Excalidraw diagrams as Claude Code Artifacts, from pasted source or a file path

plugins.name: pulse-pals
plugins.description: A band above the prompt with a tiny clay-colored avatar per agent — role as a small cap, emotion as eye color — inside a border that tracks turn status, plus a hairline pulse bar for working/waiting/done
